title: Tablefor
summary: Restaurant reservations with a host floor plan and a live kitchen board.
description: A booking site for a restaurant. Guests pick a slot and get a QR pass for the door; the host seats tonight's parties on a floor timeline and adds walk-ins; the kitchen gets full-screen tickets in real time. A rule stops a slot being overbooked and an hourly sweep marks no-shows.
roles_summary: Guests sign up and book. Hosts run the floor. Chefs work the kitchen display.
includes: Menu, opening hours and a slot picker
Bookings with a QR code for the door
highlights: Business rule: no overbooking a slot
Guests see only their own bookings
